quest.title: The Interview
quest.description: What's made headlines today? Go to The Steambird and check it out!
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x175, Primogem x60, Mora x9850, Guide to Equity x5, Adventurer's Experience x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x2

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: I'm very sorry, Charlotte, but my sister and I are quite busy today. I'm afraid we will have to decline this interview...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Oh, please, Lyney? I'll only take a moment of your time! If you would be so kind!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. What's happening here?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I spent all night writing my piece about The Phantom Weasel, and it was going to go to print this morning...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: But just as dawn broke, I suddenly received news that Cesar's fiancée, Jemma, had contacted the Gardes and confessed to having been the real Phantom Weasel all along!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That was quick!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Ahem.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Too late, bro.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Hohoho! "That was quick," you say? It sounds like I've got some catching up to do! Please, fill me in.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, whoops!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Aha! My instincts did not lead me astray — you DO have something to hide! Jemma turning herself in must have something to do with Lyney's performance last night!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Maybe watching my high-altitude escape trick reminded her of a better time with Cesar, and she could no longer ignore the voice of her conscience.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Huh, okay then... Wait, no no no, there must be more to it! If that's all it took for her to have a change of heart, how did it take her ten whole years?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Umm... Well...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Charlotte's journalistic spirit is burning red — we're going to have to distract her somehow...)

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Ah, I remember now! You and Jemma were nowhere to be found after the show... What happened between you?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Quickfire question! Where did you all go after the show?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, we went to the cemetery, and Lyney did a private magic trick, just for us!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually, glad you mentioned it, 'cause that reminds Paimon. Guess what? Lyney's started using Rainbow Roses in his tricks!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...What?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: I don't recall ever having received a Rainbow Rose from you myself. Is this supposed to mean that they're more important to you than your own sister?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: No! I, I just, uh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What the... What now? Oh, did Paimon say something wrong again, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #This is getting pretty awkward... What do we do, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: *sigh* Seems like this interview wasn't meant to be. Well, never mind — there's always next time.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Forgive my persistence, but when there's explosive news waiting to be found, I can't turn away! The news about Jemma has already made waves, and I'll stop at nothing to get to the bottom of it all!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Apparently, one of the things she said to the Gardes was that her "final wish is to see Lorenzo one last time." *sigh* There's clearly a web of complicated relationships there... Can't blame me for being curious.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Alright, I guess I'll leave you to continue the rest of your conversation in peace. Bye for now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, Lynette, Paimon didn't mean to—

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I wasn't angry. I was just trying to distract her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, really? Thank goodness. You scared Paimon there!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Phew, you and me both, Paimon, you and me both... At least it did the job, right?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...Please take good care of that Rainbow Rose.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: I'd be really upset if you lost it.
